newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea promises further food aid to North.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea promises further food aid to North.

text.p: South Korea on Friday announced additional food aid of 50,000 tonnes of corn and 300 tonnes of powdered milk to North Korea to help relieve food shortages there.
The supply, through the United Nations, is in addition to a $6 million contribution Seoul has made to the U.N. World Food Programme, a statement by the National Unification Ministry said.
The WFP has appealed for 200,000 tonnes of aid worth $98.5 million for North Korea, which is sliding into famine. The United States has pledged $25 million.
The ministry said the latest donation will bring South Korea's total contributions to the North to $245.8 million since 1995, when floods devastated the country's food crop.
This included $4.4 million donated by South Korean civic groups and delivered through the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies.
South Korea has ruled out large-scale official aid to the North until Pyongyang accepts four-nation peace talks that also would involve the United States and China.
